meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度一批互相依赖的子任务,按阶段依次执行,失败自动重试补救
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要让一大批有先后依赖的任务分成多个子任务按序跑完
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must fan out many interdependent tasks across child workers in order

howto.what: 它把有先后依赖的子任务编成一张任务图,按依赖分批并行执行,每个阶段一次运行;单个节点失败可用 retry、send、amend 单独重试、引导或改定义,已完成节点的结果会保留。
howto.when: 当你提出 “mass-ulw”、任务 DAG、分阶段 fan-out,或存在真实依赖(某任务必须先等前置任务完成)时接管。完全独立的并行任务用普通并行 spawn 更简单。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次文档刷新拆成有依赖的节点图并跑起来
say.note: 会先读 planning.md,再定义并启动运行

say.text: 把失败的 lint 节点重试一次,并改成跳过 vendored 目录
say.note: 只重跑该节点及其依赖者,已完成结果复用

say.text: 打开 /dag 看这次运行的节点状态、波次和失败
say.note: 显示各节点状态、波次与失败

howto.what_en: It turns dependency-ordered subtasks into a task DAG and drives it in parallel waves, one run per phase. A single bad node can be retried, steered with send, or amended; finished nodes keep cached results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or staged fan-out, or when real dependencies exist (task C waits on A and B). Fully independent work is simpler as plain parallel task spawns.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to break this docs refresh into a dependency-ordered node graph and run it
say_en.note: Reads planning.md first, then defines and starts the run

say_en.text: Retry the failed lint node and change its prompt to skip the vendored dir
say_en.note: Re-runs only that node and its dependents; cached results reused

say_en.text: Open /dag to show node states, waves, and failures for this run
say_en.note: Shows node states, waves, and failures
